_comment: FROZEN CROSS-LANGUAGE TEST VECTOR for the conversation token (issue #700).
The token format is signed by the agent-host (TypeScript, src/auth/hs256.ts) and
verified by the broker (Python, broker/core/conv_token.py). Two implementations of
one format is the real risk, so both test suites verify THIS token against THIS
secret and assert the same claims. A change to either implementation that alters the
wire format fails in the other language's suite.
This file is duplicated at services/broker/tests/fixtures/conv-token.json because the
two nix derivations each build from their own service directory and cannot share a
path. scripts/check-conv-token-vector.sh fails CI if the copies drift.
The secret is a test value and is not used anywhere else.
